title: The Library tile click timing walk passes again when one tile is clicked straight after another
goal: The walk that times how fast a picked title tile on the video Library shelf shows as picked now fails: when the pick moves from one title tile to the next, the first click on the second tile is never seen as picked. Either a click is really being lost, which a person would feel as a dead click, or the walk is reading it too early; find which and make it pass.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-12 on main at 5862475dd with no local change to the app (Library.swift put back to HEAD): Scripts/playtest-all.sh library-tile-click-latency-walk -> 'FAILED step 11 (timeTileClicks): click 1 on "Keynote Section" never picked it'. The step's own note in log.json: 'switching from tile to tile: "Film Super", 10 clicks: picked on screen median 14ms ... "Keynote Section" ... never picked on click 1'. Step 9 (from nothing picked) passes. library-tile-click-latency-picture-walk passes. Found while running Library walks for a-saved-stroke-tile-on-the-styles-shelf-counts-e.
acceptance: The log says whether a click was lost in the app or the walk read the pick too early, and the fix is in the one that was wrong

log.note: Verdict: the walk was wrong, no click was lost in the app. Picking Film Super opens the Title Page section above the shelf; once the double-click hold ends (shelfHoldSeconds+0.02) the shelf pane settles shorter and the title row slides under the panel's bottom edge. The walk woke ~20ms before that, found Keynote Section in reach with no scroll, then the settle moved it out of reach; settled() gave up after 2s ('never settled, pressed where it last was', measured: aimed at window y 203, inReach=false) and the click landed below the shelf. Next click had to scroll 82pt. Fix in PlaytestHarness.timeTileClicks: reach again (up to 3 looks, each scrolling) when the tile ends out of reach, and fail with the reach trouble instead of pressing beside the tile; the row in tile-clicks-N.json now says what reaching took. Walk passed 4 runs of 4 after the fix; library-tile-click-latency-picture-walk passes too. The person-facing part (picked tile slides partly out of view after the settle) is filed as a-title-tile-you-pick-on-the-video-library-stays with picture and panel listing.

The walk read wrong, the app lost no click: the shelf settled the tile out of reach and the walk pressed where it had been. timeTileClicks now re-reaches (scrolling) and fails with why instead of clicking beside a tile. library-tile-click-latency-walk passed 4 of 4, the picture walk passes, Scripts/test.sh green. Committed ae7ba9d01. The picked tile sliding out of view is filed as a-title-tile-you-pick-on-the-video-library-stays.
